thread:
sam: heads-up: user report where a streaming toolcall that gets truncated by client-side timeout triggers a retry path and we end up charging both the toolcall provisional and the resumed stream provisional. trace below.
tara: paste?
sam: 
```
2026-03-21T18:05:01Z router start session=sess-A path=/v1/stream model=r2 seq=0
2026-03-21T18:05:05Z runtime provisional claim key=conn-77 tokens=24 reason=initial
2026-03-21T18:05:06Z client toolcall invoke id=tc-9 timeout=2s
2026-03-21T18:05:08Z client timeout tc-9 -> client retries toolcall as separate request conn changes
2026-03-21T18:05:08Z router provisional claim key=conn-89 tokens=24 reason=toolcall-retry
2026-03-21T18:05:10Z runtime confirm tokens=24
2026-03-21T18:05:12Z runtime resume replay tokens=24 -> duplicate provisional seen in ledger
```
sam: customer billed for 48 tokens instead of 24.
diego: sounds like provisional idempotency key mis-scope again. toolcall path and stream path don't share key space.
tara: different from reconnect case because this is client-side retry for a toolcall inside the stream. we need a consistent id that spans both the toolcall and the resumed streaming path.
kevin: can we use toolcall-id when present as part of provisional key? that would let the toolcall retry dedupe across conn changes. fallback to session+offset when no toolcall id.
diego: careful: some toolcalls are inlined and don't have an id; also older SDKs don't set it. need backward compat.
tara: interim mitigation: treat toolcall provisional claims as "bounded overlap" and set TTL=1s plus emit telemetry to detect duplicates. but that's brittle.
kevin: longer term: (1) accept header X-Toolcall-Id from client (router propagate), (2) ledger key = session_id + (toolcall_id | stream_local_hash) + window_hash, (3) migration: on lookup, cross-check old conn-key and link.
sam: what about truncation+retries where the client retries the entire HTTP request instead of resuming? we still want dedupe.
diego: we can make the router add a stable "session_request_fingerprint" header computed from session_id + request_seq + client_nonce so retries of same logical request map to same provisional key even if conn_id changes. but need client nonce for idempotency; we can generate if client omits it by dropping into router-generated uuid and returning it in a 409 with Retry-After? messy.
tara: UX ask: add a console filter to show provisional claims that never confirmed (or confirmed twice) and a per-route rate of "toolcall_retry_dup_charges".
kevin: telemetry: add tags: provisional_role=(stream|toolcall), provisional_idempotency_hint=(conn,toolcallid,fingerprint), provisional_outcome=(confirmed,duplicate,orphaned).
sam: logs: standardize on `PROV CLAIM sid=$SID id=$ID role=$ROLE tokens=$T conn=$C` and `PROV CONFIRM sid=$SID id=$ID tokens=$T` so we can join in logs before ledger exists.
diego: migration: while we roll out the new key, ledger read path should check new-key then old-key and emit a "link" record if found under old-key. link epoch should expire after 7 days.
kevin: add a short-lived canary flag for router to start propagating X-Toolcall-Id and fingerprint. deploy to prod-labs canary.
tara: tests: unit key derivation, load test simulating rapid toolcall retries and truncated streaming. e2e: reproduce customer trace and validate single charge.
ops-bot: incident-bot: created ticket INF-4402 assigned to eng-platform "toolcall retry double-provisionals".
sam: action items: @kevin router header + log schema, @diego ledger lookup fallback + link record, @tara console filter + metric, @sam test harness + reproduce. will write RFC tonight.
kevin: add metric provisional_duplicate_rate and alert if >0.05% for post-rollout 24h.
diego: note: keep conn-key support in place for 30 days to allow clients time to update.
tara: also add a small tooltip in console explaining why provisional counts may exceed confirmed temporarily. helps reduce ops noise.
sam: thanks all, i'll file the RFC and attach the trace. :white_check_mark:
